The '''Ramsir system''' was a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the conflict known as the [[Siege of Ramsir]],<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> which was fought at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Dates">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}} establishes that the [[Siege of Ramsir]] was fought at some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and saw the participation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the Empire to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Siege of Ramsir must have occurred sometime between those two dates.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ramsir system was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
